citation.authors: Michelle L, Pouldar Foulad D, Ekelem C et al

record.population: Participants in 39 studies of periorbital hyperpigmentation; groups not stated in the abstract
record.finding: Fillers and fat grafting work best for dark circles from volume loss; blepharoplasty for loose skin; creams and peels for pigment; lasers mildly to moderately for vascular and pigment types. The authors note the scarcity of high-quality evidence and ask for more randomised trials.
